name.es: Ciclo completo de una Quick Fix sobre un modelo vivo: vista previa, aplicar, revalidar, deshacer y rehacer
name.en: Full quick-fix cycle on a live model: preview, apply, revalidate, undo and redo

pre.es: Directorio temporal escribible; recurso real introspection.ecore registrado con la cadena EMF real; documentos JSON de metamodelo, expresiones, acciones y validaciones guardados de verdad.
pre.en: Writable temp directory; the real introspection.ecore registered with the real EMF chain; metamodel, expression, action and validation JSON documents really saved.

setup.es: Sin mocks: ModelDocumentService EMF, repositorios JSON, ValidationRuntimeApplicationService, ValidationOrchestrator, QuickFixRuntimeService y bus de eventos real con un suscriptor que anota los tipos de evento.
setup.en: No mocks: EMF ModelDocumentService, JSON repositories, ValidationRuntimeApplicationService, ValidationOrchestrator, QuickFixRuntimeService and a real event bus with a subscriber recording event types.

executes.es: resolve, preview, apply, undo y redo reales de QuickFixRuntimeService contra una sesion EMF con dos reglas y dos nodos; guardado del XMI en disco para leerlo aparte; orquestacion desactivada a proposito para forzar un fallo tras mutar el modelo.
executes.en: Real resolve, preview, apply, undo and redo of QuickFixRuntimeService against an EMF session with two rules and two nodes; the XMI is saved and read back separately; orchestration is disabled on purpose to force a failure after the model was mutated.

asserts.es: Lista de seis correcciones ofrecidas; la vista previa no cambia el XMI; apply cambia el XMI, resuelve el diagnostico y revalida en modo INCREMENTAL conservando el otro problema; undo/redo y hasUndo/hasRedo; argumentos o precondicion invalidos y fallo tras mutar dejan el XMI identico byte a byte y publican failed.
asserts.en: Six offered fixes listed; preview leaves the XMI unchanged; apply changes the XMI, resolves the diagnostic and revalidates in INCREMENTAL mode keeping the other problem; undo/redo and hasUndo/hasRedo; invalid arguments, a false precondition and a failure after mutation leave the XMI byte-identical and publish failed.

behavior.es: Aplicar una correccion rapida modifica el modelo de verdad, revalida solo lo afectado, avisa por eventos y se puede deshacer y rehacer; si algo falla, el modelo vuelve exactamente a como estaba.
behavior.en: Applying a quick fix really changes the model, revalidates only what is affected, announces it through events and can be undone and redone; if anything fails the model returns exactly to how it was.

rule.es: Un apply nuevo vacia el historial de rehacer; una accion sin soporte de deshacer no guarda historial; el estado resultante distingue resuelto, sin resolver y sin cambios.
rule.en: A new apply clears the redo history; an action without undo support keeps no history; the resulting status tells resolved, unresolved and no-change apart.

scenario.es: Modelo con un nodo que incumple la regla A (con seis correcciones) y otro que incumple la regla B; se previsualiza, aplica, deshace, rehace, se rechazan argumentos, se falla tras mutar y se prueban estados sin cambios y applied unresolved.
scenario.en: A model with one node violating rule A (offering six fixes) and another violating rule B; preview, apply, undo, redo, argument rejection, failure after mutation and the no changes and applied unresolved statuses are exercised.

result.es: El XMI en disco refleja cada paso; el informe incremental solo resuelve el diagnostico corregido; los eventos started/applied/failed/undone/redone se publican; tras un fallo el XMI es identico al anterior.
result.en: The XMI on disk reflects each step; the incremental report only resolves the fixed diagnostic; started/applied/failed/undone/redone events are published; after a failure the XMI equals the previous one.

expected.es: Todas las aserciones pasan con la cadena real, sin simulaciones ni esperas.
expected.en: All assertions pass against the real chain, with no mocks or waits.

guarantee.es: El ciclo aplicar-revalidar-deshacer-rehacer y la reversion ante fallo funcionan de punta a punta sobre persistencia y EMF reales.
guarantee.en: The apply-revalidate-undo-redo cycle and rollback on failure work end to end over real persistence and EMF.

limits.es: No cubre la recompensa de gamificacion, la API HTTP ni acciones que creen o borren elementos; el fallo tras mutar se provoca desactivando la orquestacion, no con un error espontaneo.
limits.en: Does not cover gamification rewards, the HTTP API or actions that create or delete elements; the failure after mutation is provoked by disabling orchestration, not by a spontaneous error.

strengthWhy.es: Colaboradores y persistencia reales sin mocks, oraculo independiente (XMI leido de disco) y mapeo directo a cada etapa.
strengthWhy.en: Real collaborators and persistence without mocks, an independent oracle (XMI read from disk) and direct mapping to each stage.
